notes: Page opened (1 of 1-2): Ju (state). Wikidata id left null (unreachable). The two annexations (Chu 431 infobox; Qi undated in the lead) are not reconciled on the page: the end year follows the infobox and the chu dossier. The capital move from Ji (Ji 計) to Ju is undated and Ji is not located; one capital dot at Ju County. AREA: none on the page. Lu is not mentioned on the page. ea-01-b's report listed Ju with year 431 only.
